$comment: Single list of every shared capability the template cannot consume by published exact version yet. Each entry is gated: `check` fails if the capability appears in rightkit-versions.json while its stand-in still exists, if the entry is declared as a real dependency, or if its stand-in file is gone. When a package publishes: pin it exactly, delete the stand-in, delete the entry. Nothing else in the template is a local copy of shared code.

@rightkit/app-shell.blockedOn: publish to the registry (packages/app-shell 0.1.0 is built; not in rightkit-versions.json)

@rightkit/media-ui.blockedOn: publish + rightkit-versions.json entry; add only when the app shows media

rightkit-framed-sidecar.blockedOn: crates.io publish (crate exists in the RightKit checkout, absent from the registry: pin =0.1.0 fails to resolve)

rightkit-jobs.blockedOn: publish after rightkit-framed-sidecar; adds the durable job store
rightkit-jobs.standIn: none (the engine has no job store until it publishes)

rightkit-db.blockedOn: rightkit-versions.json entry; add when the app owns a database

rightkit-qa.blockedOn: distribution of the `rightkit-qa` binary to app checkouts (crate is publish=false; apps invoke the managed binary)
rightkit-qa.standIn: none (rightkit-qa.toml + tests/scenarios are the real configuration)

scripts.scripts/package-placeholder.mjs: release packaging is Node release tooling (right-release): copy GenRight scripts/{mac-dmg,win-nsis,sign-macos-bundle,install-macos-development}.mjs; fails loudly until then
scripts.src-tauri/tauri.conf.json plugins.update: endpoint + pubkey are placeholders; use the suite updater pubkey and the app's R2/GitHub endpoint
